ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity white contiguous regions in the center of both lobes; low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated at the central base and transitioning into irregular stippling and vertical streaks (rakes) extending from the trailing edge inwards.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; distinct deep indentation (notch) located on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 30% of the distance from the tip; numerous micro-peaks and valleys along the entire visible linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted from the water line to the elevated distal tips of the fluke.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast, three-dimensional pixel groups localized at the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple vertical, low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (black streaks) localized on the white ventral surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular notch on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe; heavy accumulation of biological encrustations on both fluke tips.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme lateral tips exhibit a bulbous, irregular silhouette caused by dense barnacle clusters, significantly altering the expected geometric point of the fluke tips.
